audit.summary: Both ad formats (320x480 and 300x600) have critical structural and content issues that prevent shipment. The 320x480 unit lacks proper carousel functionality and brand messaging clarity. The 300x600 unit shows color swatches but lacks product imagery and has insufficient visual hierarchy for the promotional offer. Both formats have typography and spacing issues, and the regeneration must ensure proper ad wrapper IDs, consistent branding, and adherence to the Petit Bateau style guide.

findings.issue: Carousel carousel carousel: The carousel displays abstract striped illustrations and then a product photo, but the dots suggest three slides with unclear content progression. The transition from vector striped shirt illustration to actual product fabric photo lacks narrative continuity and appears confusing.
findings.fix_hint: Redesign the carousel to show a cohesive product narrative: slide 1 (hero product image), slide 2 (lifestyle/styling), slide 3 (collection view or detail). Ensure illustrations and photos complement rather than clash. Use consistent visual language across all slides.

findings.issue: Missing or unclear Petit Bateau brand story: The ad shows '-30% SUR LA COLLECTION ÉTÉ' and 'J'EN PROFITE' CTA, but lacks the campaign headline 'LES JOURNÉES EXTRAORDINAIRES' and brand context. The copy 'Découvrez notre collection d'été avec les marinières intemporelles Petit Bateau' is generic and doesn't sell the summer campaign narrative.
findings.fix_hint: Add 'LES JOURNÉES EXTRAORDINAIRES' as a prominent secondary headline (Futura Bold) below the logo and above the discount banner. Enhance descriptive copy to emphasize the campaign theme (summer joy, marinières, family collection). Ensure brand messaging ladder: campaign > offer > product > CTA.

findings.issue: Typography hierarchy: The headline text 'Découvrez notre collection d'été avec les marinières intemporelles Petit Bateau.' is small and lacks visual weight. No clear distinction between primary copy and secondary call-to-action messaging.
findings.fix_hint: Use Futura Bold 16px for the campaign description to increase visual hierarchy. Ensure at least 4px line-height for readability in 320px width. Test squint test to verify headline reads first after discount and CTA.

findings.issue: Color consistency: The discount banner uses a gradient (red to light blue/purple), which is not explicitly defined in the primary or secondary color palettes provided. The gradient may not align with Petit Bateau brand color system (#112351, #C8102E, #FFFFFF, #F4ECDC, #FFD200).
findings.fix_hint: Apply brand red (#C8102E) as the primary banner color without gradient, or document the gradient as a secondary design element. Ensure all color choices are traceable to the style guide. If gradient is required, use only brand palette colors (e.g., #C8102E to #FFD200).

findings.issue: Product imagery missing: The 300x600 format shows only a faint illustration/icon of a product silhouette and color swatches (Rouge, Crème, Gris) for t-shirt colors, but no actual product photography. The style guide provides productPictureUrls with summer collection images; these must be visible and prominent.
findings.fix_hint: Replace or enhance the faint illustration with a high-quality product image from the style guide (e.g., marinière shirt, summer collection items). Ensure product photo occupies ~40-50% of vertical space in the 300x600 format. If color swatches are kept, subordinate them to the product hero image; don't make them the focal point.

findings.issue: Visual hierarchy imbalance: The color swatches (Rouge, Crème, Gris) are given equal prominence to the campaign headline 'LES JOURNÉES EXTRAORDINAIRES' and the discount '-30%'. The swatches should not compete with the core offer and brand messaging.
findings.fix_hint: Reduce color swatch size and opacity; position them as secondary product details below the main product image. Ensure headline and discount are larger and more visually dominant. Apply visual hierarchy: campaign name (largest) > discount offer (prominent red) > product image (hero) > color options (supporting detail) > CTA button (primary action).

findings.issue: Secondary promotional text clarity: The text '+-10% supplémentaires sur produits déjà remisés' in the discount banner is small and could be misread. The conditions text at the bottom ('Offre valable sur petit-bateau.fr et en boutique. Conditions complètes sur le site.') is in tiny print and lacks accessibility.
findings.fix_hint: Ensure secondary promotional text is Helvetica Neue 12px at minimum, with clear visual distinction (e.g., lighter color, italic style). Move full conditions to a separate link or modal; the footer text should be a brief, readable disclaimer using accessible font size (11px minimum).

findings.issue: CTA button inconsistency: The 300x600 uses 'DÉCOUVRIR' while the 320x480 uses 'J'EN PROFITE'. Both are valid CTAs but should be consistent across campaign formats for brand recognition.
findings.fix_hint: Standardize CTA copy across all formats. Recommend 'JE DÉCOUVRE' or 'J'EN PROFITE' for consistency. Ensure CTA button uses Helvetica Neue 600 (bold), all-caps, white text on brand red (#C8102E), with sufficient padding (12px vertical, 16px horizontal minimum).

findings.issue: Spacing and padding: The 300x600 layout feels dense in the middle section (color swatches and product details). There is insufficient whitespace between product section and button, reducing visual breathing room.
findings.fix_hint: Increase vertical spacing: add 16px padding above and below color swatches section, 20px padding above CTA button. Ensure the settled state maintains consistent padding throughout. Use the spacing-system skill to define a 4px/8px/12px/16px/20px/24px rhythm.

audit.regeneration_prompt: Regenerate index.html, styles.css, and app.js to fix all blockers and warnings: (1) For 320x480: Replace the abstract carousel with a cohesive product narrative (striped shirt illustration → lifestyle styling → collection hero). Add 'LES JOURNÉES EXTRAORDINAIRES' as a secondary headline below the logo. Enhance copy to emphasize summer campaign and marinières heritage. Ensure typography hierarchy using Futura Bold for headlines and Helvetica Neue for body. Remove gradient banner; use solid brand red (#C8102E) or apply brand palette colors only. (2) For 300x600: Replace the faint product icon with high-quality product photography from the provided URLs (marinière or summer collection item), positioned as hero image occupying ~45% of format height. Subordinate color swatches (Rouge, Crème, Gris) as supporting product details below the image, not as focal point. Restructure visual hierarchy: campaign headline (largest, Futura Bold 20px) > discount offer (prominent red band, Futura Bold 18px) > product image (hero section) > color options (supporting, 12px labels) > CTA button (Helvetica Neue Bold 600, all-caps, white on red). (3) For both formats: Standardize CTA copy to 'J'EN PROFITE' across all units. Apply consistent brand color palette (#112351, #C8102E, #FFFFFF, #F4ECDC, #FFD200). Ensure each ad unit has correct id attribute (id='ad-320x480' and id='ad-300x600'). Use Helvetica Neue 400 for body copy, Futura Bold for all promotional headlines, and Georgia italic for editorial storytelling if present. Apply spacing system (4/8/12/16/20/24px increments) for consistent padding and margins. Test settled state to confirm all assets load and layout holds exact pixel dimensions. Verify accessibility: contrast ratios 4.5:1 minimum for text on colored backgrounds, no color-only status indicators, readable font sizes (16px minimum for body, 14px minimum for secondary text).
